text: In the one day since the last run, electronics (about +1,080 reviews) and beauty (about +700) moved most on Amazon, led by a ₹199 Kratos selfie stick (+153) and Ghar Soaps bath bars (+84), while Diwali diya lights and clay diyas rank high on the eve of Diwali (8 November). For a beginner, sling and crossbody bags, small fitness accessories like hand grippers and simple home items look most approachable, while earbuds, personal care and beauty are led by big brands such as boAt, OnePlus, Philips and Dettol.

headline: Women's ethnic: kurta sets lead, silk-look sarees keep arriving
text: Kurta sets from GoSriKi and Klosia have the most reviews, and the fastest growers in the last day were ₹699 to ₹799 kurta sets from GoSriKi, Klosia and Nermosa, though only by 9 to 14 reviews each. Banarasi, Kanjivaram and Paithani-style sarees from C J Enterprise, Yashika and SGF11 are new to the list or rising with only a few hundred reviews, likely wedding-season buying. The typical price is about ₹699, more than double Meesho's ₹296. Among the top 10 products, about 11.6% of reviews are 1-star, so quality complaints are a real risk. Kurtas have sizes, so free-size sarees are the easier way in.

headline: Women's western: Amazon's Symbol leads, Korean-style tops rise
text: Amazon's own Symbol T-shirts have by far the most reviews, followed by Leriya Fashion dresses. Growth in the last day was small, about 80 reviews in total, with a ₹499 Greciilooks midi dress and a ₹389 Leriya shirt dress gaining most. Embroidered and Korean-style tops from RIEKA (₹645 to ₹695) and new shirts from LITZO and Greciilooks show smaller labels can still rank. The typical price is about ₹498, and among the top 10 products about 10.3% of reviews are 1-star. Sizes mean returns, so start small.

headline: Men's clothing: big brands lead, jackets and hoodies rise
text: Allen Solly, Van Heusen, Jockey and Amazon's Symbol lead with polo and round-neck T-shirts. A ₹549 Lymio lightweight jacket gained the most in the last day (+24), and hoodies and sweatshirts from Boldfit, Nobero and Lymio are rising, which fits the start of winter. The typical price is about ₹593, and among the top 10 products about 9% of reviews are 1-star. Big brands and sizes make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: Uno and soft toys lead, girls' co-ord sets arrive
text: A ₹99 Uno card game has the most reviews, followed by ₹169 to ₹179 soft toys and a ₹141 LCD writing pad. A ₹1,199 Lifelong kick scooter (+23) and a ₹940 remote control stunt car (+11) gained most in the last day, likely gift buying. Girls' co-ord sets from Tagas, Blood Panther and Fashion Dream are new to the clothing list, mostly with only a few hundred reviews. The typical price is about ₹569, and among the top 10 products about 8.4% of reviews are 1-star. Unbranded soft toys and simple learning toys are the easiest way in, with Children's Day (14 November) and Christmas ahead.

headline: Home & kitchen: Diwali lights move, Pigeon and Milton lead
text: A ₹189 Pigeon mini chopper has the most reviews, followed by Milton steel bottles and Solimo tealight candles. In the last day, a ₹259 kitchen scale (+34) and LED curtain and diya string lights from One94Store and DesiDiya (+25 to +31) gained most, and ₹51 to ₹96 clay diyas are rising, likely last-minute Diwali buying that will fade after 8 November. The typical price is about ₹259, and among the top 10 products about 11.6% of reviews are 1-star, higher than on Meesho. Shelf liners, masala boxes and kitchen mats are light, unbranded ideas that also rank.

headline: Beauty: Dettol, Vaseline and Nivea lead, Ghar Soaps keeps rising
text: Big brands lead: Dettol handwash refills, Vaseline, Cetaphil, Parachute and Nivea body lotions. In the last day, Ghar Soaps bath bars (+84) and The Derma Co face wash (+44) gained most, and a ₹199 Lumony makeup pouch (+38) shows that simple unbranded accessories can sell here too. The typical price is about ₹229, and among the top 10 products only about 5.1% of reviews are 1-star. Branded creams need brand approval, so makeup pouches and organisers are the easier beginner route.

headline: Jewellery: small list today, YouBella and Shining Diva lead
text: Only 28 products were read today because the Women's Jewellery list returned few items, so treat this category with care. YouBella bracelets and earrings and Shining Diva sets lead, priced about ₹165 to ₹300, and growth in the last day was tiny (about 15 reviews in total). New and rising are Sukkhi gold-plated sets, ZENEME pearl ear chains and a 12-pair earring box, likely wedding-season buying. Among the top 10 products about 10.7% of reviews are 1-star. Jewellery is light with no sizes, so it suits a beginner, but on Amazon it moves slowly compared with Meesho.

headline: Bags & footwear: orthopedic slippers lead, sling bags rise
text: Doctor Extra Soft orthopedic slippers have the most reviews, and Lavie handbags lead bags at ₹1,099 to ₹1,299. In the last day, Frido and Ortho Joy slippers gained most (+12, +11), and a ₹249 Wooum sling bag (+9) and crossbody bags from Walizza, Lyrovo and Flyngo (₹479 to ₹535) are rising. The typical price is about ₹568, and among the top 10 products about 8.4% of reviews are 1-star. Sling and crossbody bags have no sizes and are the easiest pick here.

headline: Electronics: boAt and OnePlus lead, selfie sticks and chargers move
text: boAt, OnePlus and realme earphones have the most reviews by far. Electronics gained the most reviews of any Amazon category in the last day (about +1,080), led by a ₹199 Kratos selfie stick with tripod (+153), OnePlus earbuds (+77) and phone cases (+62). Samsung and Apple chargers, a ₹139 Portronics cable and new iPhone 17 cases are rising. The typical price is about ₹699, and among the top 10 products about 10.1% of reviews are 1-star. Phone cases, stands and selfie sticks are possible, but earbuds and chargers are brand territory.

headline: Health & fitness: Philips and Havells lead, home gym items rise
text: Personal care is led by Dettol, Havells, Philips and Nivea, and Philips and Havells trimmers gained the most in the last day (+38, +24). On the fitness side, a ₹161 Boldfit hand gripper (+19) moved, Amazon Basics dumbbells and a Lifelong yoga mat are new to the list, and pull-up bars from Slovic and Lifelong are rising, likely new-year and winter fitness plans. The typical price is about ₹369, and among the top 10 products only about 4.7% of reviews are 1-star, the lowest here. Grooming gadgets are brand territory, but grippers, yoga mats and resistance items are light and unbranded.

Sling and crossbody bags around ₹250 to ₹530
Hand grippers and small fitness accessories around ₹160
Selfie sticks with tripod around ₹200
Makeup pouches and travel organisers around ₹200
Soft toys and simple learning toys around ₹140 to ₹180
Drawer and shelf liners, masala boxes and kitchen mats

Avoid for now: earbuds, chargers and trimmers (boAt, OnePlus, Samsung, Philips and Havells lead), branded skincare and lotions, men's branded T-shirts, and Diwali lights and diyas whose demand likely ends after 8 November.
